content.value: It is desired to illuminate a drawing hall with an average illumination of 200lux. The hall is 30X20 m2 . The lamps are to be filled 4m from ground floor. Find the number of lamps and wattage/lamp for the lighting scheme. Given efficiency of the lamps available as 25 lumens/watt, depreciation factor 0.8 and coefficient of utilization 0.75, space height ratio between 0.8 and 1.2. Give satisfactory spacing arrangement.
